verdict.rationale: jo is itself a personal AI agent. Its first-party docs describe delegating real tasks to it conversationally: building and publishing websites, creating and commenting on Linear issues, and running scheduled recurring jobs on its own always-on machine. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks complete reliably, and documentation of oversight or approval flows for delegated actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: You can ask jo to build and publish a real website, then change it conversationally.
create new issues, comment on issues
Give jo a job and a schedule. Get a weekly plan, morning priorities, or a weekend task review without asking each time.
because jo has its own machine, it can work overnight: read what came in, watch what changed, and prepare your morning before you wake.
